degree_rationale: Three Images in the perfect/elect man — pneumatic (New Man with Mind of Light dwelling), psychic (residue of New Man, Old Man bound to flesh), somatic (containing all). The Living Member redeemed daily, crossing through the three images, with the Virgin of Light leading her up to be sealed in the New Man. THE culminating natural teaching: the perfected human form.
direction_rationale: The settled completion of the natural Man — the three images at rest in their order, the soul reaching the agape-robe. This is where the Lord rests in the human; the perfected outermost form. Sunset-completion.
grand_man_function: Natural perfected man — the threefold image in which the Lord takes rest.
title: Three images in the perfect man: pneumatic, psychic, somatic
